loop.top3_series_pattern: trend_dominated with weak seasonality and unstable model ranking across windows
loop.top3_why: The series shows a strong long‑run trend and only modest seasonal signal. Model rankings are unstable (Kendall tau 0.158) and several models share correlated errors, so a robust combination is preferable. The weighted inverse‑error strategy (B) uses a stable pool (pool3) and assigns higher weight to models with lower error, mitigating the risk of over‑relying on a single model that may perform poorly in some windows. Its per‑window performance is consistently good across all three validation windows, whereas the best_single strategy (A) is highly volatile and would likely overfit to the best model in the validation set.
loop.top3_why_not: Strategy A relies on a single model that dominates only in the validation set; its performance drops sharply in one window (0.392) indicating over‑fitting. Strategy C, while also weighted, uses best‑per‑horizon weights that can over‑emphasize a model that happens to be best in a particular horizon, leading to higher variance. Therefore B offers the best trade‑off between robustness and performance for this series.
